BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.

2. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

3. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

4. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

6. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

10. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

11. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

12. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

5. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

7. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

9. C — Information and Communication Technology

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Computer Aided Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
